results.explanation: PM-KISAN provides direct income support to all landholding farmer families. As a farmer in Wardha with 3 acres of cultivable land, you qualify for Rs 6,000 per year in three installments. The amount is directly transferred to your Aadhaar-linked bank account.
results.how_to_apply: Register at pmkisan.gov.in or via nearest CSC center
results.source_quote: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a central government scheme launched in 2019 to provide income support to all landholding farmer families across India.

results.benefit: Crop insurance: Sum insured per hectare; premium 1.5-5% (farmer share), rest subsidized
results.explanation: PMFBY provides comprehensive crop insurance for farmers growing notified crops. As a cotton and soybean farmer in Wardha, you are eligible for crop insurance covering yield loss, prevented sowing, and post-harvest losses. The premium is highly subsidized (farmer pays only 1.5-5%).
results.how_to_apply: Apply through bank branch, CSC, or online at pmfby.gov.in before cut-off date
results.source_quote: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) is a crop insurance scheme launched in 2016 to provide financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage due to unforeseen events.

results.benefit: Subsidy on certified seeds: 50% for general farmers, 75% for SC/ST/small-marginal farmers (max Rs 2,000-5,000 per hectare depending on crop)
documents: Seed purchase bill/receipt from authorized dealer
results.explanation: Maharashtra Beej Unnati Yojana provides subsidy on certified/hybrid seeds for farmers in Maharashtra. As a farmer in Wardha with 3 acres, you can get 50% subsidy on seed costs (up to Rs 2,000-5,000 per hectare depending on crop). Seeds must be purchased from authorized dealers, MAHABEEJ, or MSSC.
results.how_to_apply: Apply online at mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in (MahaDBT portal) or through Taluka Agriculture Officer
results.source_quote: The Maharashtra Beej Unnati Yojana (Seed Upgradation Scheme) provides subsidy on purchase of certified/hybrid seeds to farmers in Maharashtra.

results.benefit: Revolving credit up to Rs 3 lakh (with PM-KISAN linkage); interest subvention 2%, prompt repayment incentive 3%
results.explanation: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) provides short-term credit for cultivation and allied activities. With your PM-KISAN registration and 3 acres of land in Wardha, you can get a revolving credit limit up to Rs 3 lakh. The effective interest rate is just 4% with interest subvention and prompt repayment incentive.
results.how_to_apply: Apply at any bank branch (commercial, RRB, cooperative) or online via pmkisan.gov.in KCC portal
results.source_quote: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme, launched in 1998 and revamped in 2019, provides short-term credit to farmers for cultivation and allied activities.

results.benefit: Rs 6,000 per year additional to PM-KISAN
results.explanation: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi provides additional Rs 6,000 per year to Maharashtra farmers already registered under PM-KISAN. With your PM-KISAN eligibility and Maharashtra residency, you qualify for this additional benefit, totaling Rs 12,000 per year.
results.how_to_apply: Apply online at mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in or via nearest CSC center
results.source_quote: The Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi is a Maharashtra state government scheme launched to provide additional financial assistance to farmers already registered under the central PM-KISAN scheme.

PM-KISAN अंतर्गत दरवर्षी ६,००० रुपये, PMFBY अंतर्गत पीक विमा, बीज उन्नती योजनेअंतर्गत ५०% बीज सब्सिडी, KCC अंतर्गत ३ लाख रुपये कर्ज, आणि नमो शेतकरी योजनेअंतर्गत ६,००० रुपये यशस्वीरित्या मिळतील. सर्व योजना ऑनलाइन किंवा CSC द्वारे अर्ज करा.
